name: Wand of Fireballs

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: 7 charges: Fireball (save DC 15), one charge per level above 3rd.
text: Holding the wand, spend charges from its pool of 7 to cast Fireball with a save DC of 15. One charge gives the level 3 version, and each further charge raises the spell's level by 1. It recovers 1d6 + 1 charges each dawn. After you spend the final charge, roll 1d20: a 1 means the wand crumbles to ash and is destroyed.
